name: NPower Canada Junior IT Analyst Program (free IT training)
summary: Free 15-week beginner IT training, with the Google IT Support Professional Certificate and job-search support, for young adults facing barriers to work.
whatYouDo: You attend daily technical and professional-skills training in a simulated workplace for about 15 weeks, working toward certificates such as Google IT Support. NPower then supports graduates in looking for entry-level IT roles.
appeal: Tuition-free; NPower says it never charges a fee to apply or join
No prior IT knowledge needed, only basic computer use
Industry certificates (Google IT Support; some streams list CompTIA Security+ and Azure Fundamentals)
Offered to Ontario residents (also AB, BC, MB, NS; French version in Quebec)
NPower reports over 80% of graduates employed or in school within 12 months (self-reported)
watchOuts: Eligibility per a partner info sheet: ages 18-29, high school diploma or GED, unemployed or underemployed, facing barriers, English around CLB 6/7; an older sheet said 17-30, so confirm
Mandatory online assessment and one-on-one interview; admissions makes the final decision
Daily training for about 15 weeks (session seen: April 7-July 17, 2026); next Ontario intake not confirmed
Outcome figures are NPower's own; Indeed interview reviews are mixed (about 6/10 from roughly 25 reports)
Delivery format (online vs. in person) for Ontario cohorts not confirmed

credentials: high school diploma or GED (per partner info sheet)

training.notes: Tuition-free 15-week program; NPower states there is never a fee and it will never ask for payment details.

compensation.notes: Training is unpaid; graduate starting wages not evidenced.

reliability.notes: Cohort-based intakes; job outcomes self-reported by NPower.

applicationSteps: Check current eligibility and intake dates on NPower Canada's Junior IT Analyst page
Submit the online application form (one application per person is kept)
Complete the mandatory online assessment and a one-on-one interview
If accepted, attend the ~15-week program and use NPower's job-search support
fitsIf: You are a young adult (roughly 18-29) with a high-school diploma who wants a free, structured start in IT support.
notFitIf: You are outside the age range, need income during training, or cannot commit to a daily 15-week schedule.
